entry_thesis: The live trend is a higher US policy path after October CPI at +0.4 percent: the two-year is 4.73, through 4.67, and March 2027 SOFR implied is 4.53 after a receive was stopped out from 4.33. The dollar is already trading that trend. USDJPY at 159.23 is a 20-day upside breakout, with EURUSD and AUDUSD breaking down and USDCAD breaking up over the same window. Long USDJPY is the continuation. A ten-year pay at 4.98 stays off until that tenor prints a confirmed new yield high, which is not established.

events.rationale: Open a 10 million USDJPY long with the 20-day breakout. Do not pay the ten-year without a confirmed new yield high.

invalidation: The view changes if USDJPY falls back inside the pre-breakout 20-day range, or if the hike reprice fails with the US two-year back below 4.67 and March 2027 SOFR implied back below 4.53.
